n001.name: The Heart
n001.description: The beginning of one’s journey. Progress and gain new skills.

additional.text: For certain additional roles beyond the initial, you will need to use Star Level fragments to either unlock the option or add an additional bonus effect. These are special effects that are independent of which connected route you follow and are quite powerful. When resetting the tree to choose a different flex path, the particular nodes are not refunded and remain permanent as they are similar to regular characters’ Star Level conditions.
Join a cohort at Regnum Academy for additional synergy with other characters. Attain affiliations by exploring the world and increase synergy with even more allies.

n002.name: Path of the Mystical
n002.description: Become a Mystical Being, gaining mana through inherent magical potential. Gain +800 MP as a base stat.

n003.name: Path of the Mainlander
n003.description: Become a Mainlander, a non-Mystical Being, remaining adamant of the Mystical and relying on one’s mind and physical strengths. Reject the ability to use MP and element attacks, but attack stat increases by +40%.

n004.name: Agent
n004.description: Become a stealthy assassin that bewilders enemies before striking. Increase luck by +40%, gain +5% crit hit rate, and increase movement speed by +30%. Passively gain the consistent effect [Assassin’s Touch].

n005.name: Defense
n005.description: Absorb attacks of allies and become the very best armor piercer. Increase defense by +50% and gain +15 base piercing as a stat. Whenever the third stage of the basic skill is used, gain a single stack of [Flash]. Using any special skill will grant a [Shield] equal to 200% of defense to self and allies.

n006.name: Fighter
n006.description: A warrior by heart who seeks the victory in conquering head on with strength and tactics. Increase attack by +20%, movement speed by +10%, and crit damage by +10%. When using staged basic skills, the first stage hit will apply [Valiant] to self, the second stage will apply [Dazed] on hit opponent, and the third stage will apply [Flash].

n007.name: Healer
n007.description: Become the lifeline of the party by buffing and healing self and allies. Increase health by +25% and gain +15% base healing rate stat. Apply the effect [Rapid Recovery] whenever an ally or self drops below 20% health (Cooldown: 30 seconds). All received [Shield] effects on self will be enhanced to the buff [Ultimate Shield] when health reaches below 50%.

additional.text: When receiving a buff, heal self and the party for 5% of max health. This only occurs once per instance of buff gained with a cooldown of 3 seconds.

n008.name: Water Affinity
n008.description: Gain the water affinity, dealing [Water] elemental damage from all skills.

additional.text: Unlock the Special Skill: Element Discharge.

n009.name: Earth Affinity
n009.description: Gain the earth affinity, dealing [Earth] elemental damage from all skills.

additional.text: Unlock the Special Skill: Element Discharge.

n010.name: Fire Affinity
n010.description: Gain the fire affinity, dealing [Fire] elemental damage from all skills.

additional.text: Unlock the Special Skill: Element Discharge.

n012.name: Wind Affinity
n012.description: Gain the wind affinity, dealing [Wind] elemental damage from all skills.

additional.text: Unlock the Special Skill: Element Discharge.
